verdict: SEE rnd/cards/W2_dcf_revgap_*.json -- money-first PASS at 5Y, marginal at 1Y
reason_previously_parked: Panel (rnd/panel/panel.parquet) carries NO fundamentals -- schema is technical/regime/FF6-beta only. Superseded: this pass instead used panel_long.parquet (21yr, has real fwd_ret_5Y_*) joined against rnd/panel/stock_valuation_pit.parquet (net_profit/mktcap PIT company-level basis, built by market_state.py) plus a fresh trailing-5Y-CAGR growth series from data/fundamentals/MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet.
how_built: builder=rnd/lib/builders_w2_dcf.py (build_revgap_factor + build_dcf_value_factor); runner=rnd/lib/run_w2_dcf.py; full sensitivity grid WACC in {11,13,15%} x g_terminal in {3,5%}, both factors, both horizons (24 evaluate() calls) -> rnd/cards/W2_dcf_*.json + rnd/cards/W2_dcf_sensitivity_summary.csv.

result_summary.money_first_gate_all_24: PASS (lag_test_delta<=0.25 and |placebo_ic|<=0.02 on every grid cell)
caveats: [DATA] fundamentals-join coverage starts 2013-07 (needs a 5Y-trailing net_profit history before a row is scoreable) -- panel_long's own 2005-2013 rows are unfilled for this factor, confirming pre-2012 thinness.

[DATA] harness's PBO (CSCV, N=1 adaptation) reports 0.96-0.99 on every cell and DSR reports ~0.0 on every cell -- both are KNOWN structural harness artifacts on this monthly overlapping-return sample with a shared 'W2' family trial count of 340+ (CONSOLIDATION.md harness-fix #1/#2), NOT evidence specific to this factor. Both reported as ADVISORY per money-first scoring, not used as kill criteria here.

[INFERENCE] WACC/terminal-growth are flat assumptions (no CAPM/size-premium build), net_profit/mktcap is a company-level (not per-share) EY-style basis because no shares-outstanding series exists in the fundamentals source.

ann_return_LS / net_of_cost_ann_return at the 5Y horizon are NOT real annualized returns -- harness applies a uniform x12 annualization (CONSOLIDATION.md harness-fix #4) to a 5-year cumulative long-short spread, inflating the printed number by roughly 60x; use ranking/IC only, do not quote the return figure.
